newsitem.title: USA: Lucent wins $71 mln Korea wireless contract.
newsitem.headline: Lucent wins $71 mln Korea wireless contract.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc said Thursday it received a $71 million contract from Shinsegi Telecomm Inc to supply and install a wireless network for the South Korean telephone company.
The network will cover the Pusan and Kyungnam areas, located in the southern part of the country.
The installation is expected to begin immediately, and service on the new network is set to begin in December.
Lucent said Shinsegi planned to expand its service network to cover the entire country by the end of the year.
